title: Airtel ₹379 Recharge Plan: 2GB Daily Data with Apple Music and Adobe Express Premium for free
summary: Airtel bundles free Adobe Express Premium and Apple Music with its Rs 379 recharge plan
detailed: Airtel offers a ₹379 recharge plan featuring a 1-month validity, 2GB of daily data, unlimited local, STD, and national roaming calls, and 100 daily SMS.
The plan includes unlimited 5G data in areas covered by Airtel's 5G network when using a supported smartphone.
Additional digital benefits include 30GB of Google One cloud storage, a 6-month trial of Apple Music, and a 12-month free trial of Adobe Express Premium.
The plan also bundles Airtel Safe features such as real-time spam call alerts, fraud link blocking, and free Hello Tunes.
sentences: Airtel ₹379 Recharge Plan offers 1 month validity, 2GB data per day, Unlimited Calling and 100 SMS.
Along with this, benefits like Google One, Apple Music and Adobe Express Premium are also available.
Airtel ₹379 Recharge Plan: Airtel’s Rs 379 recharge plan can be a good option for those who need daily internet, unlimited calling and some additional digital benefits in a single recharge.
In this plan, the company is giving 2GB data every day with a validity of 1 month.
It also offers unlimited local, STD and roaming calls.
Apart from this, there are many other benefits, so let’s know about them in detail.

First of all, let’s talk about the basic benefits of this plan.
Airtel’s Rs 379 recharge plan comes with a validity of 1 month.
This means users are getting 2GB data every day.
The plan also includes 100 SMS daily.
This means that there is no need to get a separate SMS pack for banking alerts, OTPs and other important messages.
Let us tell you that this plan of Airtel for calling is also designed keeping in mind the everyday use.
It offers unlimited local and STD calls to any network.
It also includes unlimited national roaming calls.
Another special feature of this recharge is its unlimited 5G data.
This data is different from the normal data limit of the plan.
Users can also use unlimited 5G data in addition to their daily 2GB data when the 5G network is available.
However, this feature is only available in areas with Airtel’s 5G network.
All you need is a smartphone with 5G support.
The plan also offers 30GB of Google One cloud storage.
With the help of this, users can save their important photos, videos and other files in the cloud.
The phone’s storage fills up quickly, especially when it has a lot of photos and videos.
For those who listen to music, this plan includes a 6-month benefit of Apple Music.
It allows users to listen to more than 100 million songs without ads.
There is also a 12-month free trial of Adobe Express Premium.
Adobe Express can be used to create social media posts, graphics, designs, and other creative content.

Airtel is also providing Airtel Safe with this plan.
These include features like real-time spam call alerts, fraud link blocking, and protection against bank frauds via OTP.
It also comes with free Hello Tunes.
Users can set a Hello Tune of their choice for free every 30 days.
